items.headline: Autodesk reported Q1 fiscal 2027 results and announced a definitive agreement to acquire MaintainX in an all-cash deal valued at about $3.6 billion.
Autodesk lowered the minimum purchase for Autodesk Flex to 33 tokens for $99, down from 100 tokens for $300, effective June 4, 2026.
Autodesk signed a strategic collaboration agreement with Amazon Web Services to advance cloud-based design and make solutions, with Autodesk products to be available in AWS Marketplace.
